contracts.name: parseThenClamp
contracts.signature: function parseThenClamp(text: string, fallback: number, lower: number, upper: number): number

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Text is at most 20 characters and any accepted value is finite. Numeric arguments are finite from -1000 through 1000; lower <= upper.
